CarConcept.glb
=============
Source: Khronos glTF-Sample-Assets — Models/CarConcept
URL: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/CarConcept
Direct: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/main/Models/CarConcept/glTF-Binary/CarConcept.glb

Notes:
  High-quality concept / grand-tourismo style vehicle (~213k triangles) with
  clearcoat, transmission, emissive strength, iridescence, and material variants.
  NOT a manufacturer OEM sedan (e.g. not Geely Xingrui). Used here as the highest
  redistributable automotive glTF sample suitable for a realistic PBR car look.
  Default paint variant selected in-app: “Torched Graphite”.
